notes: Resolves Overture Place localisation from script evidence, excludes CN or MO address country codes, retains null-country Places, and records review evidence.

mergeRules.condition: Explicit publisher locale metadata conflicts with strong script evidence; resolve the value from the text and retain the original value and evidence in the release audit.

mappings.from: publisher locale metadata conflicts with strong script evidence
mappings.to: resolve the locale from the text and record the source locale, resolved locale, script, reason, and source value

i18n.description: Records Place localisation values whose publisher locale metadata conflicts with strong script evidence.

记录发布者语言环境资料与强烈文字系统证据不一致的地点本地化值。

mergeRules.condition: The publisher address country code is CN or MO, or is missing; exclude CN/MO Places, retain missing-country Places in the Hong Kong projection, and record both cases in the release audit for review.

mappings.to: exclude Place from the Hong Kong projection and record an excluded review action
retain Place in the Hong Kong projection and record an included review action

i18n.description: Reviews Overture Places with excluded CN/MO or missing publisher address country codes; CN/MO Places are excluded and missing-country Places are retained.
審核發布者地址國家代碼為 CN 或 MO 或缺失的地點；CN/MO 地點排除在香港投影之外，缺失地點則予以保留。
审核发布者地址国家代码为 CN 或 MO 或缺失的地点；CN/MO 地点排除在香港投影之外，缺失地点则予以保留。
